sources.title: 一个从赤潮老玩家到自走棋玩家的攻略
sources.author: 邪王易风
sources.evidence: Original client card visually reviewed, not search-snippet text.
sources.clientDate: unknown; the edited article contains images from different client versions

implemented.scope: Battle-local; resets in each army creation. Energy and cooldown are separate gates. A legitimate target is checked before spending.
implemented.legacyVersion: coalitions retains the old 450% attack spell and highest-attack target selection.

localAdaptations: The card does not specify physical/magic/true damage categories. This engine maps its skill damage to magic; the existing resistance/siege/armor-blast rules apply.

Initial energy 0, 3-cell Manhattan range, base HP/attack/armor/interval, instant logical impact and nearest/current visible-target selection retain local single-player design; the card does not prove them.

Three 25% increments are interpreted additively to +75% of battle opening attack including permanent equipment/formation attack. Repair/rooster share their existing max temporary multiplier and then multiply self growth.
Shield-only or immune hits still count as successful releases; missing, dead, allied, hidden or out-of-range targets do not spend energy or begin cooldown. These are explicit consistency choices.

Control eligibility, retention of stacks through temporary charm, generic energy recovery and no ordinary lifesteal on skill damage follow the local engine; they are not reconstructed original-client formulas.

compatibility.policy: Only prepare migrates to aurora; battle/result/finished and historical rounds retain their version. No pool, economy, item, ban or seed reset.

remaining: 罗汉客户端卡的气波掌250/450/650与10秒冷却仍未实现。
其余同版本兵种属性、费用、能力与完整伤害/回能公式未完成核对。
三星/三层的自然实战覆盖、高阶构筑、标准/挑战难度和真实弱设备体验仍需完善。

followups.note: 罗汉气波掌及S04基础属性已接入，旧规则保留；原remaining为0.47历史状态，其他历史字段/高星/整体体验仍待推进。
